scope: Refresh open-source DWG/DXF peer comparison at the effective-option, route, and scale boundary; tighten existing composed peer gates without creating new findings or per-slice external validation.

sourceTypes: Current GDAL DXF and DWG driver documentation
ACadSharp signed release history and release notes
method.sourceFreshness: The documentation and release list are current public sources; mutable stable/master pages are discovery evidence. A future runtime comparison must pin the exact peer release/commit, binary/package hash, platform, operation, and effective options.
method.evidenceBoundary: Documentation establishes peer route and default behavior only. It does not prove libdxfrw semantics, peer runtime outcome for a specific artifact, complete object-graph preservation, or support parity. ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte layout.

evidence.topic: GDAL DXF driver effective defaults and projection limits
observed: Block geometry is inlined by default and block geometry merging is enabled by default.
Raw unhandled group-code capture is disabled by default.
3D extensible mode can expose raw ASM bytes and a 12-value transform for AC1027+ DXF, but does not construct solid geometry.
The writer emits AutoCAD 2004 DXF; several curves and style/coordinate properties are projected or approximated.
doesNotEstablish: Exact curve, annotation, or style semantics after OGR projection
A general 3D solid or ACIS reader
Version-preserving DXF write across all AutoCAD release targets
evidence.planUse: At the existing composed GDAL gate, pin driver version and effective options, preserve block references, record the feature cap and expected/observed counts, enable raw fields only for relevant lanes, and treat capped/inlined/merged/tessellated outcomes as incomplete for graph or exact-geometry comparisons. Use -1 only with bounded locally generated controls when deliberately exceeding the normal cap.

evidence.topic: GDAL DWG route is a distinct read-only libopencad projection
observed: The CAD driver is based on libopencad.
The documented supported elements are POINT, LINE, CIRCLE/ARC, and 3DFACE.
The driver is read-only and represents entities as OGR features rather than a complete DWG object model.
doesNotEstablish: Complete entity, table, object, handle, or owner preservation
3DSOLID, REGION, BODY, ACIS, or AcDs semantics
evidence.planUse: Use only as one optional explicit-geometry projection route. Do not count the DWG and DXF GDAL drivers as equivalent routes or as object-graph/solid oracles.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp release freshness versus feature evidence
observed: The release page identifies v3.8.0 at signed commit 3a1c66b and lists InternalsVisibleTo as its change.
Its predecessor v3.7.16 at 3feabba lists DXF decimal precision, support for tables over 32767 entries, indexing inserts by block, and other writer changes.
doesNotEstablish: Runtime fidelity for every advertised route, entity, or field
That the newest release adds a specific serializer capability
Any libdxfrw defect or independent native-application acceptance
evidence.planUse: Keep ACadSharp as an optional exact-release comparator; reuse existing precision and large-table test owners and avoid per-slice peer runs or release-number-based feature inference.

evidence.topic: ezdxf strict versus recovery operation boundary
observed: The current docs describe ezdxf as a DXF interface, not a CAD format converter or CAD kernel.
Recovery is a distinct repair/audit path; decoding errors may be logged as unrecoverable audit errors without raising a structure exception.
The docs warn that writing a recovered document with decode errors may create invalid DXF or lose data.
doesNotEstablish: Strict semantic equivalence or lossless writeback after recovery
DWG support or ACIS solid-kernel behavior
evidence.planUse: Keep normal strict reads, recovery/audit, writing, opaque retention, and geometry projection as separate peer operation rows. Recovered outcomes remain diagnostic and non-promoting.

refinesExistingOwners: existing numeric precision and large-table test owners
requiredGDALReceiptFields: exact GDAL version/build and effective driver options
expected and observed per-block feature counts
raw-code and ASM/transform fields when applicable
